title.narrative: Strengthening of the Women in Church and Society Steering Committee

description.narrative: The project contributes to the development of two strategic actions that are part of the 2024-2027 Work Plan proposed by the Animating Commission of the Women in the Church and Society Axis. The Commission is an ecclesial process of synodal character between the Latin American and Caribbean Confederation of Religious -CLAR; CARITAS ALC and the Centre for Pastoral Action Programmes and Networks CEPRAP of CELAM ; its mission is to guide the processes and lay the foundations and guidelines for the development of integral and comprehensive pastoral action, which contributes to transforming gender relations, the condition and position of women in the Church and society. They aim to broaden and strengthen the social base of the Commission of the Axis , with the participation of representatives mainly from the pastoral ministries related to the Women's Axis and from other ecclesial and/or social processes that they wish to participate, including the women who took part in the 2023 Meeting. With the meetings , including the present project, the aim is to continue the Listening process initiated in 2021 with the LAC Ecclesial Assembly, whose challenges and orientations are the founding mandate of the Axis Animating Commission; the aim is to share realities, knowledge and experiences, to identify those that would form part of the mapping, which is the second strategic activity that supports this project. Internally, the aim is to strengthen participation, inclusion and sense of identity with the being and work of the Commission, i.e. to unite the process for the achievement of its main goals, as set out in the Identity document. This project is complementary to CELAM's Triennial Project: Promoting Integral Human Development For A Just, Fraternal, United, Inclusive Continent, Caring For The Common Home In Latin America And The Caribbean.
